objective: Persist the INS-001A acquisition attribution, channel consent, relationship event, and insurance lead profile contracts inside the existing River CRM D1 boundary through additive schema and repository code, without replacing the canonical river_crm_relationships table, touching production D1, or introducing public ingress, UI, telephony, or AMS behavior.

architecture.productionPolicy: INS-001B may validate against ephemeral/local D1 only. Production migration execution is explicitly forbidden.

river_crm_acquisition_attribution.purpose: Store one current structured acquisition attribution record per relationship.

river_crm_contact_consents.purpose: Store auditable channel-specific consent and suppression state.
constraints: non-revoked status must not carry revoked_at
event_type limited to INS-001A initial event types

river_crm_insurance_lead_profiles.purpose: Persist insurance-only lead context without duplicating generic CRM contact or pipeline fields.
constraints: product_interest limited to INS-001A product interests
quote_status limited to INS-001A quote statuses

persistenceRules: Repository inputs must pass through INS-001A canonical constructors before writes.
Database rows must be mapped back through canonical constructors before being returned.
No repository may invent a second relationship identity format.
Acquisition attribution upsert is keyed by relationship_id.
Consent records remain independently addressable by consent_id and retain channel/status audit meaning.
Relationship events are append-only in INS-001B; no update or delete operation is exposed.
Event metadata is JSON serialized on write and JSON parsed on read.
Insurance lead profiles do not duplicate display name, email, phone, relationship kind, or generic pipeline stage.
Missing relationship foreign keys must fail rather than silently create orphan domain records.
D1 errors must not be converted into successful empty results.

requirements: Insert multiple channel consent records and read them.
Append multiple relationship events and verify chronological retrieval.
Insert and read an insurance lead profile.
Verify foreign-key rejection for a missing relationship.
Verify deleting a relationship cascades to its INS-001B child records.
Verify no production database identifier or --remote mode is used.

testRequirements: Map acquisition attribution to and from D1 rows.
Map contact consent boolean storage correctly.
Persist and list multiple channel consents.
Reject malformed persisted consent rows through canonical validation.
Append relationship events without update semantics.
Serialize and deserialize JSON event metadata.
Map insurance lead profile to and from D1 rows.
Upsert insurance lead profile by relationship.
Do not touch or regress existing river_crm_relationships persistence behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Exactly one additive River CRM migration is introduced for INS-001B.
All four INS-001A domain record families have D1 persistence.
All new persistence remains anchored to canonical relationship_id.
Ephemeral local D1 proof passes with foreign-key and cascade behavior verified.
No production D1 resource is contacted or modified.
No Sesh source, migration, binding, or runtime is changed.
Repository-wide existing type debt is not broadened into this slice.
Working-tree scope remains limited to the INS-001B specification and planned files.
